dcterms:description: TheSoz is a SKOS-based multilingual thesaurus containing concepts with labels in English, German, and French languages, used for evaluating machine translation in cross-lingual thesauri interlinking.
dcterms:title: TheSoz

dcterms:description: EuroVoc is a multilingual thesaurus covering a wide range of activities of the European Union, used in conjunction with AGROVOC for evaluating machine translation in cross-lingual thesauri interlinking.
dcterms:title: EuroVoc

dcterms:description: AGROVOC is a multilingual thesaurus covering agricultural and related domains, used in conjunction with EuroVoc for evaluating machine translation in cross-lingual thesauri interlinking.
dcterms:title: AGROVOC
